description: This PHP source file defines the I18NGroupAPI class within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The class provides an API endpoint for listing all internationalization (I18N) groups, including search, sorting, and pagination functionalities. It extends a base Endpoint class, implements CollectionEndpoint, and uses traits for localization services. The file includes documentation annotations for API documentation generation and references other models and services within the system.
